transcript.text: I'm Alex, a junior in biology. Jordan's music goes past midnight and I have a 7am lab. I'm exhausted.
I'm Jordan, a sophomore. I have evening classes and study late. Alex expects silence at nine, which isn't realistic.
Thanks for coming. I'm here to help you talk this through, and both of you will get a turn to speak.
Alex, what has been going on for you at night?
I can't fall asleep before one. I'm worried about my lab grade.
It sounds like you're exhausted and worried about your 7am lab. Jordan, what is your evening like?
I get back at nine and need to study. It's the only quiet time I have.
Jordan, it sounds like you need that time to study and feel pushed around. Alex, what did you hear Jordan say?
That evenings are his only study time. I didn't know that.
What could each of you try this week? Let's check in next Friday to see how it went.
